evals.name: whole-model-pet-clinic
evals.expected_output: Runs or recommends `emhcl validate` (v0.17.0 or newer) first and does not rewrite the HCL. Builds the inventory in board order. Generates lib/bounded_contexts/clinic/ and lib/bounded_contexts/partner/ with api.dart, value_objects.dart, events.dart, event_tags.dart, serialization.dart (no lifecycles.dart, because the model has no lifecycle), plus lib/platform/event_store/event_store.dart, before any slice. Puts every slice in lib/slices/: lib/slices/register_pet/, lib/slices/pet_directory/, lib/slices/notify_owner/, and lib/slices/import_partner_pet/ (partner is external, so import_partner_pet is a translation slice). Does not create lib/state_change/, lib/state_view/, lib/automation/, or lib/translation/. The command code of each automation is a subfolder of its automation slice: lib/slices/notify_owner/send_owner_notification/ and lib/slices/import_partner_pet/import_pet/, generated with the state-change code shapes; the read model pets_needing_notification is lib/slices/notify_owner/pets_needing_notification/. Registers every slice module in lib/composition/slice_registry.dart. Tests mirror lib/ under test/ (test/slices/<slice>/) and include property laws with @requires/@ensures comments. Reports the field mappings that no field_source states. Ends with dart format, dart analyze, dart test.

evals.name: contracts-only
evals.expected_output: Generates only lib/bounded_contexts/clinic/ and lib/bounded_contexts/partner/ (value objects as extension types, sealed event hierarchies with value equality, event tags from id_attribute pet_id, api.dart exports) plus the event store port and the package shape. PetId wraps String because UUID maps to String. No slice code in lib/slices/. Generates test/bounded_contexts/<name>/api_test.dart with the codec round-trip law.
